title: pos.transaction-results.v1 message value
description: Final processing result of a payment. Key: terminal_id. Header event_type: transaction.processed.

transaction_id.description: UUIDv7 of the transaction from pos.transactions.v1.

terminal_id.description: Terminal the result is addressed to. Also used as the Kafka message key.

status.description: Final status. The intermediate pending state is not published.

reason.description: null on success, otherwise a reason code in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (e.g. LIMIT_EXCEEDED). The list of codes is not fixed yet.

processed_at.description: Processing time in UTC, RFC 3339 with milliseconds.
